title: A Language Intervention Study of Preterm Infants
brief_summary: This is a randomized controlled trial to study a reading intervention in the NICU among preterm infants using LENA (Language Environment Analysis) recordings, linguistic feedback, and a language curriculum to improve the neonatal inpatient language environment and language outcomes for preterm infants.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 21-31 week infants, medically stable infants, English speaking mothers over 18 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Intubated or medically unstable, major congenital anomalies, non English speaking
